source_quotes.n_subjects: Ninety-four male Sprague-Dawley rats (350–400 g; BioLASCO, Taipei, Taiwan) were used in the experiments.
source_quotes.randomised: All animals were randomly assigned into groups for testing the effects of tFUS.
source_quotes.anaesthesia: All animals were initially anesthetized with Zoletil (65 mg/kg; Vibac, Carros, France) and Rompun (10 mg/kg; Bayer, Leverkusen, Germany) and then mounted on a stereotaxic apparatus (Stoelting, Wood Dale, IL, USA).
source_quotes.safety_notes: Quantification analysis demonstrated no significant change in GFAP immunoreactivity after $\mathrm { I } _ { \mathrm { S P T A } } = 5 0 \mathrm { m W } / \mathrm { { c m } } ^ { 2 }$ sonication compared with group 1 treatment (sham; $\mathfrak { t } = 1 . 0 6 6 , p = 0 . 3 2 8 )$ (Figure 4B).

flags.reason: The paper states a single total (94 rats) for the whole study; this includes the MEP dose-response groups (n=15/group per Fig. S1), the ISPTA=50 mW/cm2 GFAP safety cohort, and animals used only as a source of embryos for the in vitro primary-neuron experiments, which were not themselves exposed to tFUS. The breakdown exposed-vs-not is not fully reconciled in the main text.

Paper argues (Discussion) that using pulsed mode and low PRF 'eliminated' the confounding auditory effect, but this is a post-hoc argument, not a masking/behavioural auditory control condition actually implemented; classified as other.
Domain (free-field vs in-brain) of the stated ISPTA values is not specified by the paper; recorded as unspecified_domain. Values converted from stated mW/cm2 to W/cm2.

readout_other: TMS-evoked motor-evoked potentials (MEPs); GFAP, c-Fos and GAD-65 immunostaining; Fluo-4 calcium imaging in primary cortical neurons
direction_notes: Weak tFUS (ISPTA 0.338-12.15 mW/cm2) decreased MEP amplitude for up to 30 min in a dose-dependent manner; the lowest intensity tested (0.014 mW/cm2) had no effect. Decreased c-Fos and increased GAD-65 expression indicated suppression of cortical activity and increased inhibitory interneuron activity.
safety_notes: GFAP immunohistochemistry showed no significant astrogliosis or difference from sham after ISPTA=50 mW/cm2 sonication, suggesting the tFUS intensities used did not damage brain tissue.

exposures.label: Weak tFUS intensity sweep to left primary motor cortex

timing.protocol_description: MEPs were recorded for 10 min before tFUS as baseline, tFUS was delivered for a total sonication duration of 5 min at one of five mechanical-index/ISPTA levels (group 1 sham; groups 2-5: MI 0.003-0.081, ISPTA 0.014-12.15 mW/cm2), and MEP recording continued for 30 min afterward to assess post-tFUS effects. A separate safety cohort received ISPTA=50 mW/cm2 tFUS for histological (GFAP) analysis.
